front.title: The Vane Protocol for Feature Flag Rollouts

abstract.t: This document specifies Vane, a line-based protocol between the SDKs that evaluate feature flags and the evaluation service that holds them. It defines the states of a flag, the messages that change them, and the pause that protects users from a rollout that fails its checks.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: An application has many features, and each feature has a flag. An SDK sends Vane messages to the evaluation service over the network and receives the state of the flags.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHALL NOT", "SHOULD", "SHOULD NOT", "RECOMMENDED", "NOT RECOMMENDED", "MAY", and "OPTIONAL" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

dl.dd: A named switch in an application that turns a feature on for a share of its users.
The library in an application that sends Vane messages about flags.
A whole number from 0 to 100 that an owner gives to roll a flag out to that share of users.
A state in which a flag refuses every rollout for a time.

section.name: Flag States
section.t: A flag MUST be in exactly one of the states "stable", "rolling-out" and "paused".
A flag MUST start in the state "stable" when it is created.
A rolling-out flag SHOULD return to the state "stable" ten minutes after its rollout step began.

section.name: Messages
section.t: Each message is one line of ASCII text. The syntax uses ABNF .
section.sourcecode: message = rollout-request / kill-request / status-request rollout-request = "ROLLOUT" SP flag-key SP percentage CRLF kill-request = "KILL" SP flag-key CRLF status-request = "STATUS" SP flag-key CRLF flag-key = 1*32(ALPHA / DIGIT / "-") percentage = 1*3DIGIT

section.name: Rollout
section.t: A service MUST check the guardrail metrics of a flag before it applies the percentage of a rollout request.
A service MUST NOT roll out a flag while it is in a pause ().
A service MAY ask an owner for a time-based one-time password before a rollout.

section.name: Status
section.t: A service MUST answer a status request with the state of the flag and the number of failed checks since its last rollout step.
An SDK SHOULD NOT send more than one status request per second for a flag.

section.name: Pause
section.t: After three failed checks in a row, a service MUST put the flag in a pause.
A pause SHOULD last five minutes. Should an owner be able to change the duration?
A service MAY report a pause to the owners of the flag as soon as it begins.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: A rollout request travels in clear text on the network. Deployments SHOULD carry Vane over an encrypted link. This needs a requirement anchor of its own.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document has no IANA actions.
